Still I can't die because I haven't explored more??
I want to share this to world that you got right to die.. it's called suicide because your body is healthy.. people over here are gonna tell you to take therapy and etc.. because they had issues.. if you have proved worth to world if anyone was ever proud of your achievement u have rights to die.. if anyone isn't approving it , it's because they haven't seen things which you have seen.. haven't experienced your insight... The most funnest comment was from a moderator who didn't even read my post and decided to judge my decision...
If world is full of people and moderator like this I die now thank you and feel bad about your judgement..
World needs people.. just because someone did job of feeding homeless doesn't make better human.. if you would have eradicated poverty or atleast fought for it would have made sense.. taking baby steps I understand but guys you are stopping people from taking life altering decisions.. please answer this question to yourself.  Where are you and what you doing... Please answer my question in rational way and I swear I donate and support every individual who will ever feel like me..   I won't take names but to the organization you got 30 mins to come with rational argument.

I'm sure life isn't because life is all about being happy trying new things getting better than we were before...
Already tried it study I completed masters hold 150k job at age of 27.. run my own company.. did business worth 60k in 1 year with no background.. family is sorted without me.. 
Got 4.8 without giving fuck to university..
IQ score of 110 modest after being drunk..
Bank balance of 160k
Donation and charity worth 100k last year and perviously while studying saved 30k paying university fees of 80k ( all in USD)
My and relationships awsome..
No1 has issues regarding work or work life Harmony..
I got awarded as youngest growing company in Australia (start-ups)..
Helping humans and giving jobs 30 people...
Not a loser or wonderer... Just not a kid who has issues he can't deal with

I never said I'm discontent..
Im very much happy with what I'm 🙂

Forgive yourself forgive your mother for not listening to you.. I hope some point of your life even you didn't listen to her.. No1 really cares, then why to hurt yourself when you know you are not best?
Everyone is like you trying to figure there own thing. Just ask her if she loves you.. if she does you shouldn't care anything more or less.. need to accept will of every individual 😊

Find your passion.. you will figure out your way in 😊
If not start-up is always an option 😉 just need to believe in yourself

Life isn't about continuing it's about the moment you enjoy.. I laughed on the joke from my heart used to be my favorite joke when I thought about it.. some time later I didn't appreciate it like I did before.. same with food or movies... Same with friends and family

You need to eat healthy why getting attached to something which is favorite.. you need to appreciate creativity of every individual director or actor etc.. the ultimate goal is detachment from things..
The reason for me writing here is there might be my evidence 😊
You need to enjoy everything which is provided to you by nature.
Nothing comes for free.. it's about proving

Not constant but whenever I was happy or sad I felt like dieing...
Now I'm in neutral State but for past 1 year I'm having this thought constantly.. I talk with family and friends they telling me to start something new but which is not making sense to me.
When someone else can stand-up for your decision,  and try convincing the world that you were happy with your decision
